question: What ritual actions should follow after performing the Mātṛkā hand and limb placements?
premises: One should first perform the hand and limb placements of the Mātṛkā.
After performing them, one should meditate.
inference: Meditation is prescribed after completing the Mātṛkā hand and limb placements.
plain_english: Then, having performed the hand and limb placements of the Mātṛkā, one should meditate.
